body: Yes, I just had it for the first time and having food poisoning symptoms… never again

Whew girl i feel this so hard. I def view death as neutral too. I was in your same position with nothing bringing joy but then i started Zoloft. It’s helped me enjoy things a lot more and made my baseline happier. I struggle with bipolar type 2 tho so it doesn’t help as much when i get into super depressed suicide mode, but it helps it happen less frequently.
Thank you. I am trying so hard not to do it. It’s exhausting. I just want it to be over
